# naboer

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/gavinsimpson/naboer/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gavinsimpson/naboer/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/gavinsimpson/naboer/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/gavinsimpson/naboer)

naboer constructs dependence-aware cross-validation designs for
ecological and environmental data. It distinguishes observations
**assessed** by a fold from observations **omitted** during fitting,
including dependence buffers. Export these designs to `mgcv` for
NCV/QNCV smoothness selection, or to `rsample` for explicit resampling
workflows.

This is a development version. `tools/RELEASE.md` records the validation
required before 0.1.0.

## Temporal neighbourhoods

``` r

library("naboer")

observations <- tibble::tibble(
  site = rep(c("north", "south"), each = 30),
  time = rep(1:30, 2),
  response = sin(time / 5) + rep(c(0, 0.5), each = 30)
)

folds <- observations |>
  neighbourhoods(
    key = site, index = time, within = "key",
    temporal = temporal_window(time_span(2, "seconds"))
  )
tibble::as_tibble(folds, folds = 1:3, membership = TRUE)
nei <- as_nei(folds)

if (requireNamespace("mgcv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fit <- mgcv::gam(
    response ~ s(time, k = 8) + site,
    data = fold_data(folds), method = "NCV", nei = nei,
    na.action = stats::na.fail
  )
}
```

Numeric time indices are seconds. For dates, use `Date`/`POSIXct` with
elapsed or calendar spans. `time_span(1, "months", "calendar")` follows
the calendar; `time_span(3, "observations")` counts rows within an
ordered series. Tsibble keys/index and cubble metadata are inferred
automatically.

## Space and time together

``` r

if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("units", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stations <- sf::st_as_sf(
    tibble::tibble(site = c("a", "b", "c"), x = c(0, 1000, 5000), y = 0),
    coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 32632
  )
  space <- neighbourhoods(
    stations, spatial = spatial_window(units::set_units(2, "km"))
  )
}
```

Supply both window arguments and explicitly choose
`combine = "intersection"` or `"union"` for spatiotemporal
neighbourhoods. Keys identify stations or series; `.by` defines
independent domains. Multiple temporal series require `within = "key"`
or `within = "domain"`. Neither keys nor `group_by()` silently declare
independence.

## Choose a prediction task

| Task | Constructors |
|----|----|
| Predict observations beyond local dependence | [`neighbourhoods()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/neighbourhoods.md), [`buffer_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/buffer_folds.md) |
| Predict new places or periods | [`spatial_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/spatial_folds.md), [`temporal_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/temporal_folds.md), [`spatiotemporal_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/spatiotemporal_folds.md) |
| Forecast using only information available at an origin | [`forecast_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/forecast_folds.md) |
| Predict new groups, environments or taxa | [`group_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/group_folds.md), [`environmental_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/environmental_folds.md), [`phylogenetic_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/phylogenetic_folds.md) |
| Supply a custom or external design | [`custom_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/custom_folds.md), [`from_rset()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/as_rset.md) |

Inspect with [`summary()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/summary.html),
[`tibble::as_tibble()`](https://tibble.tidyverse.org/reference/as_tibble.html)
and
[`ggplot2::autoplot()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html).
Large memberships remain compressed until requested. Export estimates
packed size and defaults to a 1 GiB limit, controlled by `max_bytes` or
`naboer.max_bytes`. Million-observation sparse designs are benchmarked;
wide windows can still require enormous output.

Prepare complete modelling data before constructing folds. Rebuild the
design after changing observations or their order. A valid design
specifies a prediction task; it does not establish NCV approximation
accuracy or automatically select an appropriate dependence radius.

R \>= 4.4 is required. Spatial, temporal-class, phylogenetic, plotting
and rsample integrations use optional dependencies. See the [package
site](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/) for worked workflows and
the statistical contract.

# Package index

## Neighbourhoods and windows

- [`neighbourhoods()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/neighbourhoods.md)
  : Construct focal-observation neighbourhoods
- [`spatial_window()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/spatial_window.md)
  : Specify a spatial neighbourhood
- [`temporal_window()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/temporal_window.md)
  : Describe an asymmetric temporal neighbourhood
- [`time_span()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/time_span.md)
  : Describe a temporal span
- [`phylogenetic_window()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/phylogenetic_window.md)
  : Specify a phylogenetic neighbourhood
- [`buffer_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/buffer_folds.md)
  : Add dependence buffers around fold assessment observations

## Cross-validation strategies

- [`custom_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/custom_folds.md)
  : Construct custom cross-validation folds
- [`loo_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/loo_folds.md)
  : Leave-one-observation-out folds
- [`vfold_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/vfold_folds.md)
  : Random V-fold cross-validation
- [`spatial_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/spatial_folds.md)
  : Construct spatial cross-validation folds
- [`temporal_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/temporal_folds.md)
  : Construct contiguous temporal blocks
- [`spatiotemporal_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/spatiotemporal_folds.md)
  : Construct spatiotemporal block folds
- [`forecast_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/forecast_folds.md)
  : Construct rolling-origin forecasting folds
- [`group_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/group_folds.md)
  : Hold out observational groups
- [`environmental_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/environmental_folds.md)
  : Construct environmental cross-validation folds
- [`phylogenetic_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/phylogenetic_folds.md)
  : Construct phylogenetic cross-validation folds

## Inspect and export

- [`fold_data()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/fold_data.md)
  : Retrieve the canonical observation data
- [`assessment_indices()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/assessment_indices.md)
  [`omission_indices()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/assessment_indices.md)
  [`analysis_indices()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/assessment_indices.md)
  : Retrieve observation indices for folds
- [`as_tibble(`*`<naboer_folds>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/as_tibble.naboer_folds.md)
  : Inspect folds as a tibble
- [`summary(`*`<naboer_folds>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/summary.naboer_folds.md)
  : Summarise a cross-validation design
- [`autoplot(`*`<naboer_folds>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/autoplot.naboer_folds.md)
  : Plot selected cross-validation folds
- [`as_nei()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/as_nei.md)
  : Export mgcv neighbourhood structures
- [`validate_folds()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/validate_folds.md)
  : Validate fold membership
- [`validate_nei()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/validate_nei.md)
  : Validate a packed mgcv neighbourhood structure
- [`as_rset()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/as_rset.md)
  [`from_rset()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/as_rset.md)
  : Convert between naboer folds and rsample resamples

## Package

- [`naboer`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/naboer-package.md)
  [`naboer-package`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/naboer/dev/reference/naboer-package.md)
  : Dependence-aware cross-validation neighbourhoods
